title: BEVFormer: Learning Bird's-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers
layout_note: The overview panel is an encoder stack read bottom-to-top (history BEV and BEV queries enter at the bottom, current BEV and the heads leave at the top), entered from a left column that also runs bottom-to-top; the two detail panels hang off the right side as zooms.
grouping: Three captioned panels. (a) Overall Architecture: a left column (six camera photos ringed around a top-view car, a backbone of three stacked pills, a bracketed set of six camera feature planes) feeds by a curved arrow into a light-grey rectangle holding the encoder layer stack with 'x6' at its side. (b) Spatial Cross-Attention and (c) Temporal Self-Attention are dashed rounded containers on the right, each tied to its layer in the stack by grey dashed leader lines that fan out like a zoom.
shapes_depth: Encoder layers are flat rounded pills: teal for Add & Norm, pale lavender for Feed Forward, peach for spatial cross-attention, gold for temporal self-attention; residual arrows run up the right side of the stack. The BEV is drawn as an obliquely viewed slab of cube cells (peach for history/current BEV, blue for BEV queries); camera features are thin tilted parallelograms in six pastel colours. In (b) one pillar of query cells is outlined with red sample points stacked above it and arrows to coloured triangles on two feature planes; in (c) dots on the history BEV link by curved arrows to a query cell. Math labels (F_t, B_t, Q, (x', y', z_j')) are italic serif; box labels are sans-serif.
proposed_highlight: The two proposed attention layers are the only warm fills (gold and peach) in a teal stack, and each is expanded in its own dashed detail panel to the right, where the BEV slabs are reused at larger size; the camera views a query actually hits are circled by a green dashed ring labelled 'Hit Views'.
lesson: Draw the BEV as an oblique slab of cube cells whose colour gives its role (blue = queries, peach = BEV at t-1 and t) and reuse those slabs in the zoomed detail panels, where one highlighted pillar of cells with sample points shows where a query looks into the camera features.
notes: Venue ECCV 2022 from the arXiv comment 'Accepted to ECCV 2022' (venue_source: arxiv-journal-ref); year = that venue year. The camera photos are recorded by refs crop as embedded images and are left out of the palette.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: BEV detection and segmentation from multi-camera images

core.what: an encoder-layer stack in (a) whose two new attention layers - the only warm-filled blocks - are each opened in a dashed rounded panel at right, (b) Spatial Cross-Attention and (c) Temporal Self-Attention, tied by grey dashed callout lines and reusing the BEV slabs at larger size

relations.form: two grey dashed fan lines run from the Spatial Cross-Attention and Temporal Self-Attention blocks to the right-hand panels (b) and (c), stacked one above the other

(a) reads bottom to top: History BEV slab and BEV Queries slab enter a light-grey x6 encoder stack (Temporal Self-Attention -> Add & Norm -> Spatial Cross-Attention -> Add & Norm -> Feed Forward -> Add & Norm) -> Current BEV slab -> Det & Seg Heads

the left column reads bottom to top: six camera photos ringed around a top-view blue car -> three-pill Backbone -> bracketed set of six coloured feature planes F_t, whose curved arrow enters Spatial Cross-Attention from the left

(b) draws a pillar of cells rising from one query cell (x', y') of a blue BEV slab with red sample points (x', y', z_j') projected onto camera feature planes, the planes actually hit circled by a green dashed 'Hit Views' ring
(c) draws the peach History BEV slab beside the blue BEV Queries slab, with red curved arrows from sampled points in the history to the query cell (x, y)

channels.colour: slab colour = BEV role (blue queries, peach BEV at t-1 and t); camera feature planes each have their own pastel hue = camera identity; teal = standard layers, gold and peach = the two new attention layers; yellow highlights the query cell in the detail panels; green dashed = hit views - peach thus means both 'BEV state' and 'spatial cross-attention block'
channels.shape: oblique slabs of cube cells = BEV grids, flat parallelograms = camera feature maps, rounded pills = layers, photos = camera inputs
channels.line: solid black arrows = data flow and residuals; grey dashed fans = zoom callouts; red arrows = sampling offsets in the detail panels; green dashed ring = selection
channels.frame: light-grey block = one repeated encoder layer (x6); dashed rounded panel = an opened detail

quality.strengths: the two contributions are the only warm blocks in a teal stack and each gets its own detail panel, so space follows novelty; the detail panels draw the operation on the structure (a pillar of sample points projected into the hit camera planes; offsets from history to query); BEV slabs are taught once in (a) and reused at larger size
quality.weaknesses: peach carries both 'BEV state' slabs and the Spatial Cross-Attention block fill; the camera-feature curved arrow from the left column crosses into the stack's side; residual lines run up the stack's right edge as long right-angled wires; the detail panels repeat camera-plane hues with no key

insights.structure: (a) Overall Architecture fills the left two-thirds: a left column (six camera photos ringed around a top-view blue car, a three-pill backbone, a bracketed set of six coloured camera feature planes) feeding a light-grey encoder-layer block with ×6; (b) Spatial Cross-Attention and (c) Temporal Self-Attention are dashed rounded zoom panels stacked on the right.
insights.data: Inputs are real camera photos arranged around the ego car; camera features are flat coloured parallelograms; BEV maps (history B_{t-1}, queries Q, current B_t) are small 3-D cube grids in orange and blue; sampled reference points are coloured dots and triangles.
insights.emphasis: The two novel attention layers are the only tinted blocks in the encoder stack (beige Spatial Cross-Attention, gold Temporal Self-Attention), and each is zoomed by grey dashed lines into its own detail panel.
insights.flow: Bottom-to-top inside the encoder (History BEV and BEV Queries enter at the bottom, Current BEV and a 'Det & Seg Heads' callout exit at top); camera features enter from the left on a long curved arrow; dashed zoom lines fan right into (b) and (c).
insights.avoid: The curved arrow from the feature planes to the cross-attention block is long and the zoom wedges cut across white space; the 3-D geometry in (b) packs pillars, points and hit-view circle with tiny math labels that are hard to read.

arrangement.units: main unit (a) = input column + light-grey encoder rectangle with ×6; two detail units (b), (c) as dashed rounded containers on the right, each captioned below
arrangement.inputs_as: real multi-camera photos around a car icon at bottom-left; History BEV and BEV Queries as cube grids under the encoder
arrangement.losses_at: none; a 'Det & Seg Heads' callout at the top of (a)
arrangement.shared: the camera feature planes and the BEV cube grids reappear in the detail panels (b) and (c)
